name: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD)
info: Contagious viral disease. Mouth and foot lesions, salivation and lameness may occur.
action: Separate the animal, avoid moving livestock and contact a veterinarian promptly.

name: Lumpy skin disease (LSD)
info: Viral disease associated with firm skin nodules and fever.
action: Contact a veterinarian, isolate affected animals and discuss insect control.

name: Mastitis
info: Inflammation of the udder; milk may contain clots or change appearance.
action: Seek veterinary examination and keep abnormal milk separate.

name: Digestive disorder
info: Digestive symptoms may have many causes.
action: Contact a veterinarian, urgently if bloating is severe or breathing is difficult.

name: Papillomatosis
info: Viral warts can resemble other nodular skin conditions. Not covered by the image model.
action: Arrange a veterinary examination to distinguish from other causes.

name: Ringworm
info: Fungal skin infection that can spread to people and animals. Not covered by the image model.
action: Use protective hygiene and arrange veterinary assessment.

name: Tick infestation
info: External parasites can cause irritation and transmit disease. Not covered by the image model.
action: Discuss safe parasite control with a veterinarian.

name: Respiratory illness
info: Respiratory signs have multiple possible infectious and noninfectious causes.
action: Seek veterinary care promptly, especially for difficulty breathing.
